episodes.title: Lies
episodes.summary: Following his uncle's mysterious death, Alex Rider begins a quest for answers that leads him into a dark world of secrets and espionage. He comes to realise that his uncle wasn't the man he thought he was – and that Alex himself is expected to follow in his footsteps.

episodes.title: Interrogation
episodes.summary: Still reeling from the revelation that his uncle was a spy for the British Government, Alex is kidnapped and interrogated by an unknown group of paramilitary agents. It will take all his hidden skills to turn the tables on his captors.

episodes.title: Friends
episodes.summary: Alex is thrown into the unfamiliar world of the ultra-rich as he struggles to perfect his cover identity, but risks alienating his best friend Tom by keeping the mission a secret.

episodes.title: Deep Cover
episodes.summary: As his covert investigation of Point Blanc gets underway, Alex discovers that he's been left vulnerable. The Department seem to be closing in on the double-agent in their ranks - but the killer Yassen gets there first.

episodes.title: Secrets
episodes.summary: Appalled to realise that the students in Point Blanc are being mysteriously changed by Doctor Greif, Alex enlists Kyra and James in a plan to escape. Blunt spearheads an investigation into Parker Roscoe.

episodes.title: Escape
episodes.summary: As Tom lands in the crosshairs of the conspiracy behind Ian Rider's murder, Alex and Kyra find evidence of Dr. Greif's secret plan.

episodes.title: Incursion
episodes.summary: Alex leads a Special Forces squad back inside Point Blanc in a stealth mission to rescue his friends and stop Greif's plans.

episodes.title: Truth
episodes.summary: The Department finally solve the mystery of Ian's death and realise that an old, lethal enemy has resurfaced - while Alex faces off against his own duplicate in a desperate battle to save the people he loves.

episodes.title: Surf
episodes.summary: Trying to put the memories of his deadly mission to Point Blanc behind him, Alex takes a holiday on the Cornish coast. But when an old foe resurfaces, Alex finds himself dragged back into the world of spycraft.

episodes.title: Hunt
episodes.summary: Determined to track down Blunt and warn him about Yassen's return, Alex unknowingly puts himself on a collision course with The Department, who are simultaneously hunting a dangerous cyber-terrorist. But are the two cases more closely related than either side realizes?

episodes.title: Mirror
episodes.summary: Alex refuses to walk away from his investigation into the attack on Ed Pleasance. With Sabina and Tom's help, he discovers a new lead connecting it to the Pentagon hack, putting him in the crosshairs of the hacker who goes by the name Smoking Mirror.

episodes.title: Serpent
episodes.summary: In order to learn more about the mysterious video game phenomenon Feathered Serpent and its upcoming sequel, Alex must infiltrate a prestigious event and confront the charismatic billionaire behind the game, Damian Cray.

episodes.title: Threats
episodes.summary: To unlock the secrets of Feathered Serpent 2, Alex seeks expert assistance from an old friend. But with his own investigation spiralling out of control, how long before Blunt puts a stop to Alex's dangerous inference?

episodes.title: Heist
episodes.summary: Alex, Tom, and Kyra journey to Amsterdam to infiltrate the heart of Damian Cray's operation. Meanwhile, The Department turns its scrutiny on Cray's forthcoming meeting with the President of the United States.

episodes.title: Assassin
episodes.summary: In order to escape Amsterdam and deliver vital evidence to The Department, Alex needs Jack's help - putting her career in jeopardy. But with the President's touchdown in the UK already underway, is Alex too late to stop Cray?

episodes.title: Strike
episodes.summary: As Feathered Serpent 2 finally launches and the full scope of Cray's plan is revealed, Alex races against the clock to avert a catastrophic attack.

episodes.title: Widow
episodes.summary: Travelling to Malta in search of answers about his father's past, Alex and his best friends Tom and Kyra uncover the beginnings of a deadly plot by the criminal cabal known as Scorpia, and the identity of its charismatic and ambitious new leader.

episodes.title: Lab
episodes.summary: When the British Government receives a horrifying terrorist threat signifying Scorpia's return, Alan Blunt and the Department begin to hunt for their old enemy. Meanwhile in Malta, Alex follows the trail of the shady scientist working for them to his secret laboratory aboard a decommissioned ship.

episodes.title: Enemy
episodes.summary: Alex has been captured and Tom, Kyra and Jack must scramble to find him. As Scorpia demonstrates the power of their new weapon, Invisible Sword, Alex is confronted by Julia Rothman with some uncomfortable truths about his father.

episodes.title: Recruit
episodes.summary: Cut off from his friends and forced to work with one of his greatest foes, Alex endures a punishing induction to Scorpia, and must face off against a gang of ruthless trainee assassins.

episodes.title: Revenge
episodes.summary: Alex is sent on a mission for Scorpia to prove his loyalty, with Tom and Kyra following close behind hoping to rescue him. Meanwhile, the Department attempts to unlock the secret of 'Invisible Sword'.

episodes.title: Target
episodes.summary: Alex returns home with a dark mission of revenge. Jack, Tom and Kyra must enlist the help of unlikely allies to save Alex before he commits to Scorpia forever.

episodes.title: The Shot
episodes.summary: Captured and questioned by the Department, Alex must rely on his friends to remind him who he truly is. But are there still truths about his past the Department haven't told him?

episodes.title: Invisible Sword
episodes.summary: As Scorpia orchestrates the final stages of their plan to threaten the lives of an entire British city, Alex must go back undercover in a desperate bid to stop Julia Rothman before it's too late.
